name: 斑斑
description: 和噜噜家族是远亲，但几乎从不联系，即使是同种族的斑斑们互相之间也并不亲近。从蛋里孵出来之后就非常独立了，经常迈着毛茸茸的小腿，挥着小小的翅膀巡视领地，十分高傲。
descriptionEn: Distant relatives of the Lulu family, but they almost never keep in touch, and even Banban of the same species are not close to each other. They become very independent right after hatching from the egg, often patrolling their territory on furry little legs, waving tiny wings—quite proud.
